annotations.title: Request a catering or event quote

description: Asks a caterer, bakery or venue for a quote on a job (a wedding, a conference lunch, an office event) for a real person: the date, the number of guests and what is wanted. It is an enquiry the venue reviews and prices, like the request form on the venue's own page. Nothing is charged and nothing is accepted: the venue replies with a quote the person opens on WaitApp (list_my_quotes shows it, or the venue contacts them). A venue that asks for a booking fee with a request is not asked from here; the result gives its own request page instead. Only venues that take catering requests (search_venues shows takesCateringRequests) accept one.

date.description: The date of the job, YYYY-MM-DD, the venue's local date

description.description: The occasion and what should be catered, including dietary needs and the venue or address of the event

guestEmail.description: Where the quote should be sent. Needed for list_my_quotes to find it
